lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220055)
lines.text: That was an experience.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220054)
lines.text: This feels oddly familiar.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220053)
lines.text: I'll need to start watching my back.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220052)
lines.text: The bigger they are, the harder they are to kill.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Is that the best you have to offer?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You'll have to do better than that.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I have no time for this.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I am not impressed.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Try again.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You aren't worth my time.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Next!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I grow tired of this.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Huh, why do you bother?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I have more important matters to attend to.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Run while you still can.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You will pay for this transgression.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220042)
lines.text: My skills are wasted on you.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220040)
lines.text: Huh, this is proving easier than I expected.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22003E)
lines.text: You are quite skilled at missing me.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22003C)
lines.text: I've had about enough of you.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Heh, this is going to hurt.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I will show you the meaning of pain.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Ah, time to finish this.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Come a little bit closer.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You will regret this.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Ha! I can smell your fear from here.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Phew! Get out of my way!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Run while escape is still an option.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Do you hear it? My blade calls for you.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I have faced far worse than the likes of you.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Heh, your time would be better spent seeking sanctuary.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: If it's a fight you want.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Oh, this is going to hurt you far more than it's going to hurt me.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I will not allow you to stand in my way.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Nothing good will come of your sacrifice.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220026)
lines.text: You will perish by my sword.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You have never known pain like this.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Taste my blade!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Even easier than I expected.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Dust to dust.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: This is too easy.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Return from where you came.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: For Babylon!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I am victorious.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Father would be proud.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: It ends for you, as it has for all those who have come before!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You should be honored to die by my sword!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Slaughtered!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Death, death to all who stand in my way.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Death becomes you.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: You should have fled when you had the chance.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: A fitting end for you.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Few can match blades with me.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Alright, gather round. Let's fight!

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: So many against me, and it's still too easy.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Which of you wants to be next?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Behold your future.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Pay attention. This is what becomes of those who cross me.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Who wants to die first?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: So many choices. So little challenge.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Who among you dares to face me?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Get together. It'll make my job that much easier.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: This is all the Empress can deliver?

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Where I come from, we fight one-on-one, with honor.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: Throw down your swords or lose your arms.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: I am a desperate man. You best not stand in my way.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220086)
lines.text: I don't remember this being the correct path.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220085)
lines.text: I think this is the right path.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220084)
lines.text: This could be useful.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220083)
lines.text: That looks like it will be of help.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220082)
lines.text: This has to be good for something.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220081)
lines.text: This is here for a reason.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220080)
lines.text: I should hurry.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22007F)
lines.text: I don't have time for this.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22007E)
lines.text: I hope I am not too late.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22007D)
lines.text: Damn it! I'm running out of time.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22007C)
lines.text: I must move faster.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22007B)
lines.text: Time is of essence.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220079)

cues.text: An entire forest grown indoors. No doubt it's a breeding
ground for all sorts of evil. I'll need to take care.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220078)
lines.text: A sword. Now how do I reach it?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220077)
lines.text: Good, good. This should make things easier.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220076)
lines.text: I can barely see through this. Best I watch my back. Who knows what's lurking in the mist?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220073)

cues.text: That door. The switch that opens it has to be around here somewhere.
If only I could see through this fog.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220072)
lines.text: This is the way I should go.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220071)
lines.text: No, no, no, this isn't the right way.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220070)
lines.text: This should lead me where I need to go.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006F)
lines.text: Time runs low. I must hurry!

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006E)
lines.text: I must rest a bit.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006D)
lines.text: All of this fighting has worn me out. I need a moment to regain my strength.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006C)
lines.text: Time is of the essence, but so is my well-being. I need to pause a moment.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006B, 2200DE)
lines.text: Just a short break, so that I'm better prepared for the trials that lie ahead.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22006A)
lines.text: I must conserve my energy if I am to stop the Empress.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220069)
lines.text: I don't know how much more of this I can take.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220068)
lines.text: Soon I will face the Empress.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220067)
lines.text: My trials never cease, and were it that I never opened the sands,

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220066)
lines.text: I will change my fate.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220064)
lines.text: This is not how it was to end

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220063)
lines.text: I have failed.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220062, 2200DE)
lines.text: Accursed sands! This is your fault.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220061)
lines.text: I've never been so scared in my life.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220060, 2200DE)
lines.text: They say I cannot change my fate, but I will prove them wrong.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005F)
lines.text: The hour of my death approaches, but I will not face my fate lying down. I will fight!

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005E)
lines.text: It is time to rise and continue my quest.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005D)
lines.text: Fate is a cruel mistress, but I will free myself from her bonds.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005C)
lines.text: There may still be hope.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005B)
lines.text: It's time to finish this.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22005A)
lines.text: I'll not give up so easily.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A6)
lines.text: Damn it. Not now.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A5)
lines.text: The Dahaka!

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A4)

cues.text: Hmm. This balcony seems to lead deeper into the gardens.
I'll have to find a way up there eventually. But it's no use for now.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A3)
lines.text: This island is full of surprises. Unpleasant, painful surprises.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A1)
lines.text: The Tahaka. But so far away. Does it have business with another on this island?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2200A0)
lines.text: I am pursued by death itself.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22009F)

cues.text: I have laid waste to armies of men, faced creatures no
mortal should face, but this thing, it cannot be stopped.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22009D)
lines.text: Wait!

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22009C)
lines.text: I'd best find that woman. She's probably gone for reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22009B)

cues.text: It's as if the entire castle trembles with grief at the loss of its mistress.
Let it weep. I will soon be away from this accursed place.
I have managed to lose the Dahaka.
For now, best I stay alert.
It will return. It always does.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: It seems I've discovered one of the time-traveling portals the old man spoke of.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220097)
lines.text: What do you want from me?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220096)
lines.text: What kind of monster is this?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220095)
lines.text: Shadi must have collapsed the stone bridge.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220093)
lines.text: I must hurry and confront the Empress. Let us hope she has not completed her task.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220090)

cues.text: With this mask in my possession, all that remains is for
me to return to the throne room and confront the Empress.
But as with everything on this island, I suspect this is easier said than done.

lines.speaker: Prince
lines.text: If I cannot reach the platform, perhaps I can bring the platform to me.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22008C)
lines.text: But there is no time now for such daydreams.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22008B)

cues.text: Kylina's library. What knowledge must be contained within?
I suspect there is much she could have taught me had things gone another way.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 22008A)
lines.text: Able to break down walls. This sword is powerful indeed.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220089)

cues.text: I fear my time runs short. While I rush about activating towers,
no doubt the Empress is busy creating the sands.

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220088)

cues.text: Excellent. It seems to be in much better condition
this time around. Now how do I get it working?

lines.speaker: Prince
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 220087)
lines.text: Ugh, it's only a tangle of vines. This island must be getting to me.

lines.text: Alert the others!

lines.speaker: Pirate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 230031)

trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 25005D)
lines.note: Pirate and Initiate barks are recorded by three voices in one template order; text from the clearest take
lines.text: Soften him up for me!

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 25005E)
lines.note: Pirate and Initiate barks are recorded by three voices in one template order; text from the clearest take
lines.text: You should never have come to our island!

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 25005F)
lines.text: Attack him! Do not let him escape!

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250060)
lines.note: Pirate and Initiate barks are recorded by three voices in one template order; text from the clearest take
lines.text: Don't kill him yet! I will deal the final blow!

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250061)
lines.text: You're disappointing me, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250062)
lines.text: So weak, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250063)
lines.text: I expected more of a challenge, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250064)
lines.text: Is this all you have to offer, my prince?

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250065)
lines.text: This is not the outcome I expected, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250066)
lines.text: Go ahead, fight with all your might. You cannot win, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250067)
lines.text: I trust you're prepared to die, my prince. You will not walk away from this fight.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250068)
lines.note: Pirate and Initiate barks are recorded by three voices in one template order; text from the clearest take
lines.text: Well fought, my prince.

lines.speaker: Initiate
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 250069)
lines.note: Pirate and Initiate barks are recorded by three voices in one template order; text from the clearest take
lines.text: Impressive, my prince.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 270010)
lines.text: Prepare to fight. Prepare to die.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I want to win with honor. Get back on your feet.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I'm sure you can do better than that.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: Unfortunate that you have fallen so easily.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: Rise up, prince. Let us continue this.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: Do you see now how it's done?

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I see there is still much I can teach you.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: You'll need to try harder if you hope to best me.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: Defeat does not suit you, Prince. Get back on your feet.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I find this display of weakness surprising.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I did not expect you to fail so quickly.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 270005)
lines.text: You cannot win, but you continue to fight. I am impressed.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 270004)
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Come on, human. Is that all you've got?

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: It looks like even I cannot escape my fate.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I'm not finished yet.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: Unfortunate, but it must end this way.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: It is an honor to die by your hand.

lines.speaker: Crow Master
lines.text: I salute you, Grace.

lines.speaker: Thief
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 28000D)
lines.text: Be warned, Prince. I am more woman than you can handle.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: I love being so close to you.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Poor prince, come to me.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Submit!

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: You like the pain, don't you?

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Oh yes, this position suits you.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Come closer, Prince. I want to taste my victory.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Fight harder, Prince. Harder.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Hit me harder, Prince. Harder!

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: Don't you know not to strike a woman?

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: I'm not here to hurt you.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Can't we talk this out?

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: The pain is exquisite. I commend you.

lines.speaker: Thief
lines.text: There's so much pleasure in pain.

lines.speaker: Thief
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 280015)
lines.text: This is the end.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: You shouldn't have come here.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: You would destroy all I have created. I will not allow it.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: I've seen your future and it does not look good.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: You will not leave this island alive.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Worship at my altar, whether you wish it or not.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: This is not over.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Killing me will change nothing.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: You're making a grave mistake.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Time heals all wounds.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: I will not submit.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Prince, you cannot change your fate.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290013)
lines.text: What is written in the timeline cannot be changed.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290014)
lines.text: I expected greater things from you, Prince of Persia.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290015)
lines.text: How does it feel, Prince, to come so far and fall so swiftly?

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290016)
lines.text: Your fate has been known since you set foot on this island.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290017)
lines.text: Arise, Prince. There is so much for you to do, and so little time in which to do it.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290018)
lines.text: While you rest, the Empress continues her work.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290019)
lines.text: Hmm. You're still here. Interesting.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 29001A)
lines.text: The hourglass runs low. You haven't much time.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 29001B)
lines.text: You are lucky to live, Prince. Take this opportunity to leave and never return.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 29001C)
lines.text: Yours is a fool's errand.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 29001D)
lines.text: It would be better if you stayed down, you're wasting your time.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 29001E)
lines.text: Haven't you learned your lesson? It seems not.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Fool, I am the Empress of Time. I know your every move. Before you do.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: I will always be one step ahead of you, Prince. You cannot harm me.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: You are wasting your time. I can see the future.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Impossible! How could I have failed to see this coming?

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Your powers, they're greater than mine.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: Haha, it will take more than a simple sword strike to penetrate my defenses.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: This is not right. How have you defied the timeline?

lines.speaker: Kaileena
lines.text: I can see the future. Why did I not see this?

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290029)
lines.text: If you finish the next tower, I'll be here, waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290028)
lines.text: Time is a luxury that you do not currently have, Prince of Persia.

lines.speaker: Kaileena
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 290027)
lines.text: The door remains closed.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: You call yourself a master swordsman?

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: Is this the best you have to offer?

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: The Empress will be pleased with my success.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: Flee while it's still an option, fool.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: You have no place on this island.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: You have two choices, run or die!

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: This is just the beginning.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: I will not fail the Empress.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: You don't honestly believe you can defeat me.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: I'll not give you the satisfaction of seeing me fall!

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: How can this have happened?

lines.speaker: Shahdee
lines.text: Tell me when you're going to be ready to fight for real.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0012)
lines.text: Fool. It's as I told you. You cannot change your fate.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0013)
lines.text: The Empress worried for nothing.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0014)
lines.text: He was a fool to challenge my mistress.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0015)
lines.text: Submit, Prince. You're only succeeding in wasting your time.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0016)
lines.text: Rise. Rise so that I can strike you down once more.

lines.speaker: Shahdee
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2A0017)
lines.text: Leave this island, Prince. While escape is still an option.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: You cannot escape your fate.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: You are quick mortal, quick to die.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: Come to me. Come to your death.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: Disrupt the timeline no further!

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: You will be removed!

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: Your end is near.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
lines.text: All who have come before you have fallen.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2B000E)
lines.text: It ends for you the same as all who seek to change their fate.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2B000F)
lines.text: A good fight, but this outcome was inevitable.

lines.speaker: Dahaka
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 2B0010)
lines.text: It was a mistake for you to even try. You will never be rid of me.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: Don't you know, Prince, you can't kill a shadow?

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Poor Prince, seems you're just out of reach.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: Just like your own shadow, Prince, you'll never be free of me.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: I'm here, I'm there, I'm everywhere.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: One step closer the prince, two steps back.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: The shadow falls.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: How did you manage to catch me?

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: I return to the shadows.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.text: I'm slipping away.

lines.speaker: Silhouette
lines.note: Parakeet and Whisper large-v3 disagreed; reviewed by hand
lines.text: No, no, get away from me.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350000)
lines.text: I knew nothing good would come of this.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350001)
lines.text: I am sorry, my prince. It could end no other way.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350002)
lines.text: No man is stronger than fate.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350003)
lines.text: Madness. You're trying to do the impossible.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350004)
lines.text: I admire your passion, but you'll need more than that if you hope to survive.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350005)
lines.text: Good luck, Prince. You're sure to need it.

lines.speaker: Old Man
trigger: No static reference in the game data; started by engine or script code (events 350006)
lines.text: You cannot change your fate. No man can.
